# Feature: godot detect doctor

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-14 — issue #42 -->

## Intent
A Godot repo is detected from `project.godot` / `.gd` / `.csproj` with evidence and 0–1 confidence. Missing Godot binary blocks doctor and run (exit 3) with expected version and the paths that were checked.

## Preconditions
- Adapter SDK (#32)
- Generic unknown mode (#34) so a Godot-only tree is not treated as Web

## Happy Path
- [x] `project.godot` fixture is detected with evidence
- [x] Doctor without a binary blocks launch (SCN-003)
- [x] No required `packages/core` file changes (NFR-011)
- [x] Touched files: zero type escape hatches

## Edge Cases
- [x] Missing binary lists concrete checked paths, not "install godot somehow"
- [x] Addon is not copied
- [x] Detect is read-only

## Regression
- [x] web-threejs still detects web/vite/threejs
- [x] Unknown empty dirs stay generic
- [x] Dashboard token stays out of localStorage

## Assumptions
- Kind `godot` is adapter-owned; core `CandidateKind` is unchanged
- Expected engine is Godot 4 when `config_version=5`
- UI copy is English

## Security Coverage
- Detect is read-only (no writes, no addon copy)
- B-04: doctor locates binaries via path join + stat, not shell strings
- F-03: no tokens in localStorage
- Out of scope: F-01, B-01, launch/collect

## Implementation Notes
- New package `@potato-boost/adapter-godot`: detect (`project.godot`, `.gd`, `.csproj`) and doctor (env/PATH/well-known paths).
- CLI/local-api merge Godot candidates without changing `packages/core`.
- Missing binary is required/missing; addon check is unsupported and not copied.
- `git diff packages/core` is empty (NFR-011).

## Composition Gate
- Verdict: CLEAR
- HEAD_SHA: WORKTREE
- Event: detect Godot markers → doctor looks up binary paths → missing binary blocks run (exit 3).
- N-actors: one repo → one doctor/binary lookup; no spawn.
- Invalid: missing binary lists checked paths and fails closed (exit 3).
- Two consumers: CLI doctor/run/ci and local-api doctor share `runGodotDoctor`.
